action.message:
Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: Wrapped the list_editable POST processing loop in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` with `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`. This ensures that the bulk-edit saves (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) for all changed objects are committed atomically, preventing partial/unexpected database states if an error occurs mid-loop. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
